result.summary: Found 2 visible layout issues: right-edge carousel content is awkwardly clipped, and the fixed bottom navigation overlays the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The rightmost item in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off at the viewport edge, including its restaurant name and delivery details. The category row also ends with an unexplained partial chip.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel card widths, spacing, and right-side padding. If partial cards are intended as a scroll cue, ensure text stays contained within each card and uses a deliberate ellipsis.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card, hiding a substantial portion of its image/content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable feed equal to the full navigation and safe-area height so all card content can scroll above the overlay.
